changeSet.sql: UPDATE resource SET name = btrim(regexp_replace(name, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '\1\2', 'gi')), description = CASE WHEN description IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE btrim(regexp_replace(description, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '\1\2', 'gi')) END, location = CASE WHEN location IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE btrim(regexp_replace(location, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '\1\2', 'gi')) END, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE lower(concat_ws(' ', name, description, location)) ~ '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)';
